author: Inside Edition
description:
A group of burglars dubbed the "Bear Spray Gang" broke into a home in Studio City, California. Brave neighbor Steve Calabro ran outside to confront the burglars before getting hit with bear spray. The same burglars allegedly struck the next day at a $4 million home and sprayed the family's dog Chloe with the burning repellant. Moments later, the masked men ran off with pillowcases stuffed with jewelry and family heirlooms. Security footage captured the getaway car.

A GoFundMe has been set up to help Calabro save his home. For more information, you can click this link: https://www.gofundme.com/f/save-steves-home-after-his-heroic-act
title: Group Of Burglars Break Into Homes Armed With Bear Spray

author: Inside Edition
description: A U-Haul truck took deputies on a wild chase, but it was a skilled PIT maneuver that brought it to an end. The Paulding County Sheriff in Georgia released video of the truck driving recklessly on the roads. Deputies in Cobb County issued a “Be On The Lookout” for the truck. Once it was spotted in Paulding County, several sheriffs' vehicles pursued it. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: U-Haul Truck Chase Ends When PIT Maneuver By Deputy Tips It Over

author: Inside Edition
description: A police officer begs a woman to spare her own life after she was found sitting on the edge of a high-rise building with her feet dangling over the side. The NYPD released this video of the responding officers interacting with the distraught woman. She allowed the officer to hold her hand through an opening in the glass barrier, but he would have to wait for backup to arrive to help her further. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: NYPD Comforts Distraught Woman Sitting On Edge Of High-Rise Building
